name: 071-ocr-layout-newspaper
description: Rendered full-page layout: Two-column newspaper with masthead and headlines. Scored as raw CER and as markup-neutral CER (the gating number). Classical gates require the tessdata_best eng.traineddata cache (NV_OCR_TESSDATA); model gates require DeepSeek-OCR weights.
expected_text:
THE COASTAL OBSERVER
Vol. XII, No. 34 - Saturday Edition
Harbor Renovation Enters Final Phase
The decade-long effort to restore the
eastern breakwater reached a milestone
this week as engineers poured the last
of the reinforced concrete caissons.
City officials expect the harbor to
reopen to commercial traffic by early
October, weather permitting.
Local fishermen, who have rerouted
through the narrow channel since 2019,
welcomed the news with cautious
optimism.
Funding for the project came from a
mix of federal grants and municipal
bonds totaling 48 million dollars.
An oversight committee will publish
its final audit in November.
Meanwhile, the marina association is
planning a reopening festival with
boat parades, food stalls, and a
lantern ceremony at dusk.
Organizers expect several thousand
visitors over the weekend.
Tide Tables, Page 7 | Classifieds, Page 9 | Weather: NE winds 10-15 kt

scoring.raw: character edit distance against expected_text verbatim
scoring.neutral: same distance after nv-ocr tests/markup_neutral.rs::markup_neutral (port of real5/score.py::strip_markup + whitespace collapse); this is the gating number

notes: two-column newspaper with masthead and headlines
